products.body_html:
Your nails can sparkle like freshly fallen snow!  Knitted Mittens are the perfect winter accessory to keep your hands toasty and dry. And this polish is the perfect accessory to keep your hands gorgeous through the winter and into spring. A delicate lavender shade with a hint of holographic sparkle. Opaque in 2-3 coats.
